title: Fill the basket on the way home and pay later in the evening
story: Mia gardens on weekends and orders what she needs on her phone on the way home from work. She pays in the evening, when she is back at her laptop.

days.title: An ordinary evening
situations: Fill the basket on the way home and pay later in the evening

steps.did: Opened the shop on the phone
Put a pair of gloves in the basket
Closed the shop and opened it again later
steps.expected: The gloves are still in the basket

steps.did: Looked for when the delivery comes
